E0049

Teaching: `.0` field access → named members (S73, D-SG7)

What

Teaching: `.0` field access → named members (S73, D-SG7)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0049

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0049: tests/ui/tuple_numeric_field.stderr.

Error [E0049]: Jet doesn't use numeric field access like `.0` (S73)
  --> tests/ui/tuple_numeric_field.jet:3:13
    |
  3 |     print(p.0)
    |             ^
 Why: `.0` looks like the start of a decimal number, so tuple members must have names
 Fix: name the members when you build the tuple: `(x: 1, y: 2)`, then read `p.x`
